scope: Bevart teglverksbygning med ringovn, ikke det nedlagte Bryn Teglverk og ikke Den Norske Zinkhvidt-Fabrik.

evidence.conclusion: Property number 18 is identified as former Kristiania Teglverk; number 14 is identified as the former Den Norske Zinkhvidt-Fabrik.
Identifies the surviving timber-frame brickworks with north-east brick gable and intact ring kiln at no. 18; distinguishes neighbouring historic works.
Describes preserved Kristiania Teglverk at no. 14, in conflict with building-specific sources.
Local historians explicitly corrected confusion between Bryn Teglverk and Kristiania Teglverk, highlighting the surviving kiln.

assessment.basis: Two building-specific references agree on 18 and distinguish 14 and 18; Oslo byleksikon records contradictory 14.
assessment.warning: Do not copy the coordinates of the street article: those locate Nils Hansens vei generally, not the kiln building or a public entrance.

release_blockers: Confirm exact building footprint and cadastral number from municipal property/building records

Confirm right building in photo and licensing; reject Bryn Teglverk imagery
